summary: Shows meta examples: flushing handlers right after a template, refreshing inventory after creating a cloud instance, clearing facts, clearing host errors after a failure, resetting the SSH connection so new group membership applies, and ending the play for CentOS 6 hosts with end_host.
questions: How do I make a user's new group membership take effect in the same play?
How do I skip the rest of the play for certain OS versions?
How do I run handlers right after a task?
How do I refresh inventory after provisioning a new instance?

answer_card.title: meta module examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.template:
    src: new.j2
    dest: /etc/config.txt
  notify: myhandler
- ansible.builtin.meta: flush_handlers      # run handlers now

- ansible.builtin.meta: refresh_inventory  # after creating instances

- ansible.builtin.meta: clear_facts

- ansible.builtin.meta: clear_host_errors  # bring failed host back for next play

- ansible.builtin.user:
    name: '{{ ansible_user }}'
    groups: input
- ansible.builtin.meta: reset_connection   # new groups apply to current login

- ansible.builtin.meta: end_host
  when:
    - ansible_distribution == 'CentOS'
    - ansible_distribution_major_version == '6'
```
